stem_book: (One or more than one option may be correct) If w₁, w₂, w₃ and w₄ are the magnitudes of work done by the gas in isothermal, adiabatic, isobaric and isochoric reversible expansion of an ideal gas respectively (each starting from the same initial state; the first three reaching the same final volume), then (a) w₃ > w₁ (b) w₁ > w₂ (c) w₂ > w₄ (d) w₄ > w₂
reason: Added 'magnitudes of work done by the gas, same initial state and final volume' — under the IUPAC sign (expansion work negative) the inequalities would reverse.
work: From the same state to the same V₂: area under isobar > isotherm > adiabat > isochore (0) ⇒ w₃ > w₁ > w₂ > w₄ = 0
